parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic control knob located on the front panel of the oven.
parts.Functional_description: Used to adjust temperature or mode settings of the oven.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axis to change settings.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A plastic control knob similar to the first one, part of the oven’s control interface.
parts.Functional_description: Used to control a specific burner or oven function.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates to adjust the heat or function level.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: Another plastic knob on the oven’s control panel.
parts.Functional_description: Allows the user to control another heating element or setting.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates to modify the selected setting.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A fourth plastic knob located on the oven’s front interface.
parts.Functional_description: Used to control an additional function such as timer or grill mode.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates to adjust the desired function.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the oven made of stainless steel, providing structure and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: Supports all internal and external parts, provides insulation and protection for heating elements.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; does not move during operation.
